stepCatalog.doc: 'step.babysit.watch': the human says 'merged' (with the merged sha), 'rework' (with why it goes back to build) or 'stuck'.
'step.brief.questions': what the idea leaves open; 'asked' with up to five questions, or 'ready'.
'step.brief.seed' (idea-to-brief): the empty round-1 answers and log, so the log is an output and never also an input.
'step.brief.write': the cited brief from the idea and the answers; 'written' or 'empty'.
'step.build.amend': writes the owner-frozen child phase packet with the granted paths; 'amended' with it as the packet in force.
'step.build.checks': the scope gate, the build rules and the repo's commands; 'pass' with the built head and the change, 'failed' or 'outOfScope' with findings.
'step.build.green': implements in atomic commits inside the allowed files; 'built', or 'blocked' with a request.
'step.build.prepare': checks the phase worktree is clean at its recorded head and seeds the facts every later wait reads; 'ready'.
'step.build.red': one failing test per visible acceptance item, committed as 'test: …'; 'written' with the red tests.
'step.build.red-check': runs the red tests on the red commit; 'red' when every one fails, 'vacuous' (with findings) when one passes.
'step.build.scope-desk': the owner's call on a file outside the allowed ones, human-only: allow, revert or stop.
'step.checks': outcomes 'passed' and 'failed', with 'fact:findings' required on 'failed'.
'step.design.apply': folds the stop-2 revision into the sections it affects; 'applied' with the changed sections.
'step.design.check': the draft-stage design checks (coverage, signals, decisions, contract edits, style); 'pass' or 'gaps' with findings.
'step.design.draft': one spec draft in the house style; 'drafted'.
'step.design.evidence': checks the design evidence and assembles the candidate design packet; 'complete' or 'incomplete' with findings.
'step.design.intake': loads the frozen scope packet and the style and lens packs; 'fresh' or 'revise' (a revision from stop 2); every outcome carries the eight round-1 seeds.
'step.design.lens-desk': the lens rounds hit their cap with findings left; human-only: accept them as known risks, revise with notes, or drop.
'step.design.revise': fixes the lens findings and answers the rest in writing; 'revised' with the changed sections.
'step.desk.choose': the desk twin of a route state; the human picks one of that state's choices.
'step.interview.answer': the owner's answers to the questions (the form is built from 'fact:questions'); human-only. 'doneAsking' also closes the interview.
'step.interview.apply': folds the answers into the map, list and open questions; 'updated', or 'rescope' when an answer changes the surfaces.
'step.interview.questions': the behaviour gaps as up to five questions; 'asked' or 'none'.
'step.interview.record': appends the latest batch to the answer log once, by its digest; 'recorded'.
'step.judge.choose': one choice question; outcomes are the 'choices' names plus 'uncertain'; 'fact:decision' written by the engine.
'step.lens.log': appends the report to the lens rounds; 'next' (a lens is still queued), 'clean' or 'findings'.
'step.lens.round': queues the pack's lenses for a round; 'ready'. 'pack' names the lens pack (a profile key).

'step.lens.run': runs the queue's next lens through the fixed frame; 'reviewed' with 'fact:lensReport'. 'subject' ('design' or 'change') says what the frame reads, so the subject's own facts are not descriptor inputs; 'bundle' ('lenses') copies the pack's files into the Step directory.
'step.phase.decide': the owner rebuilds the phase with notes or stops it.
'step.phase.drift': 'same' when review left the proven head unchanged, 'moved' with the new built head and change when it did not.
'step.phase.seed': checks the phase packet and its dependencies, prepares the worktree, and writes the round-1 value of every fact a later wait reads.
'step.plan.check': the plan checks and aw-packets validate; 'pass' or 'gaps' with findings.
'step.plan.evidence': checks the design and plan evidence and assembles the candidate plan packet; 'complete' or 'incomplete' with findings.
'step.plan.exec-review': each phase as its builder (four answers); 'executable' or 'objections' with findings.
'step.plan.freeze': re-checks and freezes the design, plan and phase packets together; 'frozen' or 'mismatch'.
'step.plan.graph': the phase graph; 'drafted'.
'step.plan.holdout': hidden scenarios into the holdout store; 'written' with the sets (ids and hashes, never text).
'step.plan.intake': loads the candidate design and frozen scope packets; 'loaded' with the seven round-1 seeds.
'step.plan.questions': turns the open decisions into the stop's questions; 'asked' or 'none'.
'step.plan.review': the after-design stop, human-only: approve, revise the design, revise the plan, or drop.
'step.plan.settle': compares the answers with the design's assumptions; 'assumed', 'changed' (a design revision) or 'replan'.
'step.produce': outcome 'done', with the required output 'fact:output'.
'step.prove.before-after': each fix item's recorded script must fail at the base and pass at the head; 'pass' or 'fail', the result on both.
'step.prove.evidence': the proof checks, then assembles and machine-freezes the proof pack; 'complete' or 'incomplete' with findings.
'step.prove.fail-log': every failure path ends here; writes what failed as findings for the builder; 'logged'.
'step.prove.holdout': runs the hidden scenarios against the head in the running app; 'ran' with the verdicts.
'step.prove.holdout-log': records the verdicts, marks failures spent and checks the canary; 'passed', 'failed' or 'leaked'.
'step.prove.intake': loads the phase's proof signals and seeds the facts the later waits read; 'ready'.
'step.review.fix': fixes the findings; 'fixed' with the new 'fact:change'.

'step.review.log': appends the lens report to the round's log. 'next' while the queue is not empty; at the round's end 'clean' (zero blocking and zero issue), 'findings', or 'behaviourWrong' (a blocking finding that the behaviour is wrong), the running 'fact:review' on each of those three.
'step.review.recheck': reviews the fixed head; as 'step.review.run'.
'step.review.record': writes the review result packet (rounds, each finding with its class and resolution, the last verdict, the head sha) and machine-freezes it; 'recorded' (line spec DTC4).
'step.review.round': starts a review round; queues the review pack's lenses that apply to the changed paths, in pack order, and seeds the round's log. 'ready'.
'step.scope.anchor': the brief's anchors from the context engine's text shape; 'anchored'.
'step.scope.challenge': a second model's look for missed surfaces and behaviours; reports only its own round.
'step.scope.challenge-log': appends the round to the challenge record and re-reports its verdict; a verdict that disagrees with its items is a failed Step.
'step.scope.check': the draft-stage checks; 'pass', or findings on 'gaps' (the drafter can fix) and 'regather' (a lens must run again).
'step.scope.draft': the scope map and the acceptance list from the lenses; 'drafted'.
'step.scope.evidence': every check, the packet assembled in the run area; 'complete' re-reports five facts, 'incomplete' and 'regather' carry findings.
'step.scope.freeze': re-checks the packet, confirms its hash and freezes it through aw-packets; 'frozen' or 'mismatch'.
'step.scope.gather': the four lenses over the anchors, assembled from its Step inputs; 'gathered'.
'step.scope.intake': what to scope, sorted into one of four readers; every outcome carries the eight round-1 seeds.
'step.scope.propose': submits the map's new surfaces as draft proposals and records each surface's graph status; 'proposed' or 'skipped'.
'step.scope.read-brief': reads the brief file (or its named section); 'read' with the brief and its anchors, or 'empty'.
'step.scope.read-change': reads the change's diff, commits and PR body; 'read' or 'empty'.
'step.scope.read-tracker': reads the tracker project or issue through the tracker port; 'read' or 'empty'.
'step.scope.reanchor': anchors the changed map from the context engine's text shape; 'anchored'.
'step.scope.review': the owner's stop, human-only: approve, revise (notes become answers) or drop.
'step.scope.withdraw': withdraws the run's undecided map proposals; 'withdrawn'.
'step.ship.freeze': proof, review and hand-off agree on one head; 'frozen' or 'stale' (with 'fact:findings').
'step.ship.green': the local GREEN gate on the head; 'green' or 'red' (with 'fact:findings').
'step.ship.open': the desk opens (or updates) the pull request from the frozen hand-off, or refuses; 'fact:pr' on opened and updated.
'step.ship.pack': assembles the hand-off draft, the evidence pack as the PR body.
'step.ship.return': writes why the phase goes back to build.
'step.verify': outcomes 'accepted' and 'rejected', with 'fact:findings' required on 'rejected'.

stepWith.prompt: How big is this change? Check the sizes from xl down and pick the first whose condition holds. A workstream is a group of surfaces built and reviewed as one PR series. Judge from the scope map, the lens coverage and the acceptance list.
choices: xl: more than six workstreams, or two or more outcomes that could each ship alone: split before design
l: four to six workstreams, a data migration, or a permission or notification change that spans features
m: two or three workstreams, or a schema change with no data migration
s: one workstream with two or more surfaces, and no schema change
xs: one workstream with one surface, and no schema change

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.ship.open': the desk opens (or updates) the pull request from the frozen hand-off, or refuses; 'fact:pr' on opened and updated.
nodes.next: Open {item}'s pull request from the frozen hand-off (or refuse it). Nothing reaches the forge by itself.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.ship.return': writes why the phase goes back to build.
nodes.next: Write why {item} goes back to build.

recipes.description: Block recipe: review the phase's change one lens per run, a round per iteration, to zero blocking and issue findings, at most 5 rounds, then one narrow re-check; a clean review ends through a recorded, frozen review packet.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.review.round': starts a review round; queues the review pack's lenses that apply to the changed paths, in pack order, and seeds the round's log. 'ready'.
nodes.next: Start review round {loop.rounds}/{loop.rounds.cap} on {item}'s change: queue the review lenses that apply.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.lens.run': runs the queue's next lens through the fixed frame; 'reviewed' with 'fact:lensReport'. 'subject' ('design' or 'change') says what the frame reads, so the subject's own facts are not descriptor inputs; 'bundle' ('lenses') copies the pack's files into the Step directory.
nodes.next: Review {item}'s change through the next lens in the pack.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.review.log': appends the lens report to the round's log. 'next' while the queue is not empty; at the round's end 'clean' (zero blocking and zero issue), 'findings', or 'behaviourWrong' (a blocking finding that the behaviour is wrong), the running 'fact:review' on each of those three.
nodes.next: Append the lens report to {item}'s review rounds and decide: next lens, clean or findings.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.review.fix': fixes the findings; 'fixed' with the new 'fact:change'.
nodes.next: Fix the blocking and issue findings of round {loop.rounds}; answer the rest in writing.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.review.recheck': reviews the fixed head; as 'step.review.run'.
nodes.next: Round cap reached: have one reviewer re-check only the fixes.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.review.record': writes the review result packet (rounds, each finding with its class and resolution, the last verdict, the head sha) and machine-freezes it; 'recorded' (line spec DTC4).
nodes.next: Write and freeze {item}'s review result packet.

recipes.description: STUB until the PR babysitter (BD/PB spec) lands: one human-only Step stands for babysitting, docs sync and the owner's merge; the real inputs, outputs and terminals, so workflow.phase validates and runs.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.babysit.watch': the human says 'merged' (with the merged sha), 'rework' (with why it goes back to build) or 'stuck'.
nodes.next: Stub for the PR babysitter: watch {item}'s pull request through CI, review and docs sync, then say what happened: merged, or back to build with notes.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.produce': outcome 'done', with the required output 'fact:output'.
nodes.next: Produce the Step output for {item} (round {loop.revisions}/{loop.revisions.cap}).

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.checks': outcomes 'passed' and 'failed', with 'fact:findings' required on 'failed'.
nodes.next: Run the Step's deterministic checks.

nodes.stepDoc: 'step.verify': outcomes 'accepted' and 'rejected', with 'fact:findings' required on 'rejected'.
nodes.next: Review the output as the verifier.
